en-US.title: Collecting small moments of healing can recharge your dopamine! Hongcheon-Sokcho Trip Vlog Together
en-US.description:
This is a vlog of a 2-day, 1-night trip from Hongcheon to Sokcho filled with simple healing and laughter 🫶

I went with the members of the band Peach Planet!

One of the things I hadn't accomplished on my 2025 bucket list was traveling with the members.

I feel proud that I achieved it this year quickly and in a fun way 👀

#TravelVlog #DomesticTravel #Sokcho #Hongcheon #AlpacaWorld #PeachPlanet

[Timeline]

00:00 Opening

00:19 Day 1 Begins

00:42 Lunch is Makguksu (📍Wonmi Makguksu)

- 1172 Garakjae-ro, Hwachon-myeon, Hongcheon-gun, Gangwon-do

- It's a kimchi hotspot!!

01:26 Alpaca World

- 146-155 Deokbatjae-gil, Hwachon-myeon, Hongcheon-gun, Gangwon-do

- 🦙 Admission tickets and some items were provided free of charge by Alpaca World. (This video was created based on my own subjective experience, without any guidance from the brand.)
04:03 Taking a walk with an alpaca💕

- I was a bit nervous because I heard alpacas might spit(?)

But they were surprisingly well-behaved and so, so nice.

05:01 Feeding the budgerigars

05:42 Browsing the merchandise shop

06:27 Cherry blossom view cafe (📍Daon)

- 517 Seoraksan-ro, Sokcho-si, Gangwon-do

07:09 Takeout dinner (📍Umjine - Dried Seafood Instant Grill - E-Mart)

- Umjine's cockle bibimbap was savory and had a lot of cockles!! - You definitely have to try the sashimi at E-mart too lol

07:36 Food binge

08:02 Board games before bed (Telestrations - Clue)

10:06 Day 2

11:12 Hot potato ongsimi (📍Gamnamujip Gamja Ongsimi)

- 110-8, Jungangsijang-ro, Sokcho-si, Gangwon-do

11:52 Master Bakery (📍Kim Seong-su Bakery Sokcho)

- 1F, Building 2, 9, Jungang-ro 129beon-gil, Sokcho-si, Gangwon-do

12:23 Sokcho-exclusive Life 4-cut

12:52 Cafe with delicious coffee (📍Chilseong Shipyard)

- Chilseong Shipyard, 45, Jungang-ro 46beon-gil, Sokcho-si, Gangwon-do

- The cat is very friendly! 14:02 From Cheongcho Lake to Cheongchojeong Pavilion, Cherry Blossom Viewing

14:48 A Quiet Coastal Stroll (📍Cheongganjeong Beach)

15:42 Hot and Hearty Chicken Jjamppong (📍Sokcho-ssi)

- 16, Yeongnanghaean 8-gil, Sokcho-si, Gangwon-do

- The chicken jjamppong, salted with snow crab paste, was quite rich and spicy.

- The half-and-half squid sundae is affordable, so order one and try dipping it.

16:42 A Must-Visit Spot in Sokcho

snippet.title: 고즈넉하니 계속 머물고 싶었던 하동 여행
snippet.description:
이번에 제가 방문한 곳은 모두 하동군이 선정한 하동핫플이에요.
🌿 오늘 영상은 하동군의 유료광고를 포함하고 있습니다.

✅ 카페 리화
- 경남 하동군 하동읍 섬진강대로 2496
- 하동군 할머님들이 운영하는 실버카페
✅ 따신골녹차정원
- 경남 하동군 화개면 섬진강대로 3480-25
- 성아원픽! 지리산 녹차밭, 섬진강을 보면서 피크닉
✅ 청학동다소랑정원
- 경남 하동군 청암면 삼신봉로 96 청학동다소랑정원
- 고양이가 친절하고 귀여운 고즈넉한 정원
✅ 하동샬레
- 경남 하동군 악양면 덕계길 19-2 하동샬레
- 감성 빈티지 숙소, 사장님이 아주 친절하심!
✅ 매암제다원
- 경상남도 하동군 악양면 악양서로 346-1 매암다원문화박물관
- 녹차밭이 보이는 창 앞에서 따끈한 녹차 한 잔
- 넓~~은 녹차밭 산책
✅ 카페 정서리
- 경남 하동군 악양면 정동상신길 68
- 말차라떼가 시그니쳐인 따뜻한 공간
✅ 하동책방
- 경상남도 하동군 악양면 악양동로 176 악양생활문화센터 1층
- 폐교를 리모델링해서 운영 중인 책방
✅ 하동 축지리 문암송
- 경남 하동군 악양면 대축길 91
- 천연기념물
✅ 계절열매
- 경남 하동군 하동읍 군청로 141 계절열매
- 하동의 제철 식재료로 만드는 브런치
